original.Body: Danny collects bottle caps and wrappers. He found 65 wrappers and 5 bottle caps at the park. Now he has 31 bottle caps and 9 wrappers in his collection.
original.Question: How many more wrappers than bottle caps did danny find at the park?

thoughts.current:
Step 1: Calculate how many more wrappers Danny found at the park than he already had.
65 (wrappers found at the park) - 9 (wrappers in his collection) = 56 wrappers

Step 2: Calculate how many more bottle caps Danny found at the park than he already had.
5 (bottle caps found at the park) - 31 (bottle caps in his collection) = -26 bottle caps

Step 3: Calculate the difference between the number of wrappers and bottle caps Danny found at the park.
56 (wrappers difference) - (-26) (bottle caps difference) = 56 + 26 = 82 (more wrappers than bottle caps)

Answer: Danny found 82 more wrappers than bottle caps at the park.
